recommended_placement_m.note: No placement specified in section 6.1; place outside robot base and arm paths, facing -X.

notes: Geometry in the common prop frame, Z up, front -X. CPU Cycles 64-sample diffuse colour times (0.4 + 0.6 AO); Smart UV 66 degrees. Full PBR in source.blend. Opaque sign artwork has original check, magnifier and cross symbols, English DejaVu Sans Bold. Plastic border depth 5 mm is included in the sign collider.  Task 13 delivery: baked albedos are Lanczos-downsampled to at most 1024 px except the unchanged-resolution factory-floor repeat tile; previews are 512 square. PNG encoding uses RGB8 or reviewed 256-colour Floyd-Steinberg palettes; source artwork pixels and source.blend are retained. Shared PNG paths resolve from this prop folder. Task 13 compact OBJ exception: positions use 5 decimal metres where safe; necessary vertices retain up to 6 decimals to preserve nonzero triangles, strict collision convexity and the 0.005 mm Euclidean movement bound. Independent fixed-5 rounding cannot satisfy all three. Normals/UVs use 4 decimals; every original triangle, position index and per-corner attribute value is retained. Equal rounded UV records share indices and visual OBJ indices use shorter equivalent relative notation. No collision remeshing, reindexing or simplification.
